verdict.rationale: Marketing pages claim Deel can 'process payroll globally' and 'run accurate, compliant payroll' across countries, but no evidence describes an ops-facing flow of reviewing hours/earnings, previewing totals, and submitting a payroll run in one sequence — the API/MCP tool list (contracts, time-off, EOR cost comparison) contains no payroll-run, hours-review, or totals-preview/submit tools. Missing for 10: documentation or screenshots of a hours/earnings review step, a totals preview step, and a submit action forming one payroll-run flow.
